scenes.headline: Rehearse the hard call with AI first.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Act as a tough client who thinks my price is too high. I'll pitch you. Push back with 3 realistic objections, one at a time. After each answer, tell me what was weak and give me a stronger line.
Send this to someone with a big call coming.
scenes.note: Real people react differently. Use it as practice.
